spoken_text: Let me explain how the jury will judge your work. You will be judged on technology, design and business, and on how innovative the idea is. A tech concept is an idea based on digital technology. It does not have to be a finished product.
slide_text:
Judging criteria
Technology, design, business, innovativeness

spoken_text: There are two prizes: one for best technology and design, and one for best business. The jury has people from BTH and Hyper Island together with Ericsson.
slide_text:
Two prizes
Best technology/design and best business

spoken_text: Hand in your work on day two at half past three, in your team folder on the Google Drive. Slides or a video, five minutes. Keep it short and show what works.
